title: AI Value Trace v0.3
description: Graph data model for the AI Value Trace. A directed multi-graph that maps a customer's board outcomes through business initiatives, operating metrics, functions, AI capabilities, and accountability layers to vendor components. Designed for use by enterprise account leaders running a Trace on a named account before a CIO meeting.

industry.description: Industry overlay anchoring the Trace. Mirrors the BVF protocol industry enum.

account_context.description: Optional grounding for a named account. The Trace is most useful when these are populated.

geography.description: ISO region, e.g. EU, US, APAC, or a country code.

vendor_stack.description: Current vendor footprint at the account. Used to anchor VendorComponent leaves.

reframing_questions.description: Per-path reframing questions. Populated by run_trace. One question per Trace path.

NodeType.description: BoardOutcome, what the board reports against (revenue, margin, capital efficiency, risk-adjusted return). BusinessInitiative, a named programme moving an outcome. OperatingMetric, what gets measured day to day (DSO, CAC, churn). Function, the 8 functions from the BVF protocol. AICapability, the gen1/2/3 capability that automates a function. AccountabilityLayer, the human node that gates any agent (Chief AI Officer, CFO, BU head). VendorComponent, the named product surface that delivers the capability.

EdgeRelation.description: moves, BusinessInitiative -> BoardOutcome. instruments, OperatingMetric -> BusinessInitiative. tracks, Function -> OperatingMetric (the function tracks the metric). automates, AICapability -> Function. gates, AccountabilityLayer -> AICapability (no agent without an accountable human). delivers, VendorComponent -> AICapability.

id.description: Stable id, dot-separated namespace, e.g. board.revenue-growth, function.cx, vendor.netapp-afx.

label.description: Human-readable label. British spelling, no em-dashes.

industry_scope.description: Industries where this node is canonical. Empty array = universal.

function_scope.description: Only set for Function and OperatingMetric nodes. Maps to the BVF protocol function enum.

ai_tier.description: Only set for AICapability nodes. gen1=RPA, gen2=GenAI, gen3=agentic.

evidence.description: Source citations supporting this node, source name and year.

confidence.description: 0 to 100. Derived from BVF four-pillar score when scoring against a customer initiative.

hypothesis.description: true if this edge was added by propose_edge during a live Trace, false if it is part of the industry template.

source.description: Source name. McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Gartner, Forrester, Prosci, MIT NANDA, World Economic Forum, EU Commission, named regulator.

path_id.description: Identifier of the path this question reframes, e.g. board.revenue-growth->vendor.now-assist-banking.

question.description: One question, containing a tension or paradox, that forces the C-suite to test an assumption.

TracePath.description: An ordered sequence of nodes and edges from a BoardOutcome to an AICapability or VendorComponent. Populated by run_trace, not stored in the graph.

nodes.description: Ordered node ids, top to leaf.

accountability.description: Node id of the AccountabilityLayer node on this path. Missing accountability flagged separately.
